entries.title: Catch Circle
entries.ai_quote: Catch Circle: remake as a Bauhaus tap game with a tested core

gameplay.input: Clicked the playfield to start, then clicked the visible red target disc with a real Playwright mouse click inside the exact game frame.
gameplay.response: HUD score and BEST changed from 0 to 38; streak changed from 0 IN A ROW to 1 IN A ROW.

entries.title: Crazy Eights
entries.ai_quote: Crazy Eights: remade as a parlour table that takes the colour of the suit in play

gameplay.input: Clicked the legal eight of spades, then selected spades using the in-game chooser inside the exact game frame.
gameplay.response: The played card left the hand; the visible hand count fell from five cards to four.

entries.title: point & line
entries.ai_quote: point & line: Dodge the Obstacles remade as a risograph dodge game

gameplay.input: Clicked the playfield and pressed ArrowRight inside the game frame.
